invariants.write_boundary: Only graphify/ may change; Codebase/ is read-only; no backups, archives, repository copies, builds, tests, installs, or lockfile changes.
invariants.single_root: WP-I0-001 is the only root package and is strictly read-only; it must not start another package automatically.
invariants.dag_acyclic: The dependency graph has zero cycles; every dependency has a PASS B reviewed row.
invariants.declaration: The only active readiness declaration is 'FULL IMPLEMENTATION PLANNING 100% COMPLETE — WP-I0-001 MAY BEGIN'; the old declaration is superseded everywhere active.
invariants.membership_currency: Every package packet agrees exactly with the requirement-membership ledger in count, objective, contracts, tests, and exit gate.
invariants.component_dependency: Every component consumer depends on the component decision package; no component lists its own decision package as a consumer; no rejected component has consumers.
invariants.review_provenance: Every actionable requirement, membership, and dependency has a REVIEWED_CONFIRMED row with item-specific rationale.
invariants.determinism: Layer 1 and Layer 3 hashes each match across two runs; no volatile timestamp enters deterministic artifacts.
invariants.external_integrity: Added/removed/modified/renamed outside Graphify are all zero.
invariants.structural_validation: L21 validates structured amendment objects, not substring presence in JSON dumps.
invariants.no_false_certification: Saved PASS text is never trusted alone; every validator level re-executes its checks.
invariants.gated_certification: A PASS final certification is written only after every prerequisite gate completes and L20 independently re-verifies all evidence; missing Layer 3 files, hardcoded empty arrays, hash mismatches, and unexplained exclusions fail the certification.
invariants.provisional_not_certified: Every persisted certification state before the final atomic publication is status PROVISIONAL with the NOT CERTIFIED / IMPLEMENTATION BLOCKED declaration, implementation_planning_100_percent_complete false, first_allowed_package null, the final-validation blocker, and the determinism plus final-validation gates PENDING; a PASS certificate with any PENDING or NOT_RUN gate is rejected (final_pass_published_before_all_gates_complete).
invariants.layer3_exact_membership: Layer 3 files, fileHashes keys, and fileCount exactly equal the canonical LAYER3_FILES in deterministic sorted order; missing canonical members, unexpected members, and file/hash key disagreements fail with layer3_canonical_member_missing, layer3_unexpected_member, and layer3_file_hash_membership_mismatch.
invariants.strict_exclusion_sets: Layer 1, Layer 3, and full-manifest excluded sets must exactly equal their canonical exclusion sets and every exclusion must carry a non-empty specific rationale; missing fields, missing/unexpected members, and missing/empty/generic rationales fail.
invariants.administrative_block: Implementation remains blocked pending GPT-5.6 independent review.
